command.name: Sudden Strike
verbatim: Rounds 2, 4, 6, 8: 25% chance to afflict Weakened on 1 Enemy within adjacency. This chance is doubled (50%) against targets afflicted with Bleed.
Rounds 2, 4, 5, 6, 8: Deal Physical Damage to 2 Enemies within adjacency (Damage Rate: +40%).

vanguard.name: Warrior's Resilience
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard Reduce your Damage Received by -8%. Increase Tactical Damage Dealt by +16% of the Ally deployed in the Left Flank.

habits.name: Headlong Into Danger
habits.verbatim: Start of Round 4: Increase your Strength by +25%, Initiative by +10%, and Physical Damage Dealt by +25% for 4 round(s). However, also increase your Physical Damage Received by +10% and reduce your Instinct by -40% for 4 round(s).

habits.name: Stone Bulwark
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Reduce the Tactical and Fire Damage Received of 2 other Allies in any lane by -2% until the end of combat.

habits.name: Adaptive Guard
verbatim: When leading Archers Start of Round 4: Reduce the Tactical Damage Received of 3 Allies in any lane by -9% for 4 round(s).
When leading Shieldbearers Start of Round 4: Reduce the Fire Damage Received of 3 Allies in any lane by -9% for 4 round(s).

habits.name: Fire Ward
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Grant yourself and 1 other Ally within adjacency 1 stack of Fire Ward. At the start of each round, if the target Ally retreated in the previous round, grant yourself 1 stack of Fire Ward. Each stack of Fire Ward reduces the target's Fire Damage Received by -5% until the end of combat.

habits.name: Turn the Line
habits.verbatim: Start of Round 4: Increase the Physical Damage Received of 2 Enemies within adjacency by +9% for 4 round(s).

formation_needs: A Bleed source to double the command's Weakened chance
derived.notes: Likely best in Vanguard to protect itself and enhance a Left-Flank Tactical attacker; its troop-conditioned six-star defense favors the listed affinities.
